title: Whiboard — the AI whiteboard
excerpt: The AI whiteboard. Bring your ideas to life: describe an idea and Whiboard draws the plan, the steps and the shapes that explain it. Then shape it with your team and keep the file.
content_html:
The AI whiteboard: Bring your ideas to life.

Describe an idea and watch Whiboard draw it: the plan, the steps to make it real and the shapes that explain it. Then shape it with your team, on a board you can always take with you.

Start free Try a board, no account

Free plan with 3 AI prompts a day. No card needed.

Ask in plain words

If you can say it, Whiboard AI can draw it.

  • Plan a product launch in 4 steps
  • Turn these notes into a flowchart
  • Draw a web app on AWS with a load balancer and Postgres
  • Explain how OAuth sign-in works, with shapes
  • Map the checkout flow, and what happens when a card fails
  • Lay out a 6-week roadmap with milestones
  • Brainstorm 10 names for a coffee shop
  • Sum up this board: decisions and action items
  • Group these sticky notes by stage of the customer journey
  • Read the proposal on the board and draw its timeline
  • Turn this whiteboard photo into a clean diagram
  • Draw an org chart for a team of 12
  • Make every sticky about pricing orange
  • Show how a request travels through our services

Draw your ideas, skip the blank page.

From a thought to a board your team can work on, in three steps.

  1. 01

    Describe it

    Type the idea, paste rough notes or attach a photo of a whiteboard. Documents already on the board count too.

  2. 02

    Watch it draw

    It lays out frames, steps, shapes and connectors, then looks at the board to check its own work.

  3. 03

    Make it yours

    It is all ordinary shapes and notes: move them, restyle them, undo step by step, and edit together live.

Plan it. Explain it. See it.

Sketch to understand, plan the steps, and draw the shapes that carry the idea.

  • Plan

    Turn an idea into steps

    Ask for a plan and get a frame with the steps in order, connected, each with a first task on a sticky note.

  • Understand

    Sketch it to get it

    Flowcharts with decisions and outcomes, so a process makes sense at a glance.

  • Explain

    Shapes that tell the story

    System diagrams from containers, connectors and real cloud and brand logos.

  • Summary

    Sum up the discussion

    Key points, decisions, action items and open questions, from the board or your selection.

  • Organize

    Sort a wall of notes

    Sticky notes grouped into themes, each in its own frame. One ⌘Z puts them all back.

  • Ideas

    Ideas when you are stuck

    5 to 20 fresh ideas that skip what the board already says. Keep only the ones you like.

  • Context

    Works from what you have

    Attach photos or video, or let it read the documents, spreadsheets and decks on the board.

  • Review

    Checks its own work

    It looks at a picture of the board after drawing, and every change it makes is one undo step.

Then shape it together.

Everything the AI draws lands on a live board like this one. Drag to look around.

A real board, embedded here with one iframe.

  • Live cursors
  • Comments and @mentions
  • Version history
  • Viewers never pay

Keep every board.

Every way out is a file you can open without us.

Read the promise

  1. 1

    Export on every plan

    PNG, SVG, PDF, draw.io and JSON are on the free plan, and exporting will never become a paid feature.

  2. 2

    Files you can read

    Backups are plain, versioned JSON. Never encrypted, never a format only we can open.

  3. 3

    Leave with everything

    Your account or a whole workspace downloads as one file. A downgrade never deletes a board.

Free: unlimited boards, 5 editors, 3 AI prompts a day, no card. Team: $5 per editor a month. Viewers never pay.

Pricing details

Questions

Straight answers.

  • What can the AI draw?

    Plans with steps and tasks, flowcharts, mind maps, system diagrams with real cloud and brand logos, sticky notes, text and frames. Describe it in words, paste notes, attach images or video, or point it at a document on the board. It also sums up a board, sorts sticky notes into themes and suggests ideas. Everything it draws is ordinary content: edit it, restyle it or undo it one step at a time.

  • Is the AI free?

    Yes. The free plan includes 3 AI prompts a day (up to 250,000 tokens a month), with no card. Team adds 1M tokens per editor a month and Business 3.5M, pooled for the whole workspace.

  • What if I want to leave?

    Take everything with you. Every board exports to PNG, SVG, PDF, draw.io or plain JSON on every plan, and your account or a whole workspace downloads as one JSON file. Nothing is encrypted and a downgrade never deletes a board.

  • Can I import boards from another whiteboard app?

    Yes. Import → From Miro… copies frames, sticky notes, text, shapes, cards and connectors from that app through its API, up to 10,000 items at a time; your token is used once and never stored. draw.io files and Whiboard JSON backups drop straight onto a board. Encrypted backup files from other tools can only be read by the tool that made them, so those cannot be imported.

  • Do my teammates need an account?

    Viewers don't: anyone with a share link can open the board. Editors join the workspace; the free plan has five seats per workspace and you can own five workspaces. On Team, guests can also edit from a link without an account.

The AI whiteboard

Bring your next idea to life.

Free plan with 3 AI prompts a day. No card, and every board exports whenever you want.

Start free Try a board, no account

content_html_zh:
The AI whiteboard: Bring your ideas to life.

Describe an idea and watch Whiboard draw it: the plan, the steps to make it real and the shapes that explain it. Then shape it with your team, on a board you can always take with you.

Start free Try a board, no account

Free plan with 3 AI prompts a day. 无需卡。

Ask in plain words

If you can say it, Whiboard AI can draw it.

  • Plan a product launch in 4 steps
  • Turn these notes into a flowchart
  • Draw a web app on AWS with a load balancer and Postgres
  • Explain how OAuth sign-in works, with shapes
  • Map the checkout flow, and what happens when a card fails
  • Lay out a 6-week roadmap with milestones
  • Brainstorm 10 names for a coffee shop
  • Sum up this board: decisions and action items
  • Group these sticky notes by stage of the customer journey
  • Read the proposal on the board and draw its timeline
  • Turn this whiteboard photo into a clean diagram
  • Draw an org chart for a team of 12
  • Make every sticky about pricing orange
  • Show how a request travels through our services

Draw your ideas, skip the blank page.

From a thought to a board your team can work on, in three steps.

  1. 01 Describe it Type the idea, paste rough notes or attach a photo of a whiteboard. Documents already on the board count too.
  2. 02 Watch it draw It lays out frames, steps, shapes and connectors, then looks at the board to check its own work.
  3. 03 Make it yours It is all ordinary shapes and notes: move them, restyle them, undo step by step, and edit together live.

Plan it. Explain it. See it.

Sketch to understand, plan the steps, and draw the shapes that carry the idea.

  • Plan Turn an idea into steps Ask for a plan and get a frame with the steps in order, connected, each with a first task on a sticky note.
  • Understand Sketch it to get it Flowcharts with decisions and outcomes, so a process makes sense at a glance.
  • Explain Shapes that tell the story System diagrams from containers, connectors and real cloud and brand logos.
  • Summary Sum up the discussion Key points, decisions, action items and open questions, from the board or your selection.
  • Organize Sort a wall of notes Sticky notes grouped into themes, each in its own frame. One ⌘Z puts them all back.
  • Ideas Ideas when you are stuck 5 to 20 fresh ideas that skip what the board already says. Keep only the ones you like.
  • Context Works from what you have Attach photos or video, or let it read the documents, spreadsheets and decks on the board.
  • Review Checks its own work It looks at a picture of the board after drawing, and every change it makes is one undo step.

Then shape it together.

Everything the AI draws lands on a live board like this one. Drag to look around.

A real board, embedded here with one iframe.

  • Live cursors
  • Comments and @mentions
  • 版本历史
  • Viewers never pay

Keep every board.

Every way out is a file you can open without us.

Read the promise

  1. 1 Export on every plan PNG, SVG, PDF, draw.io and JSON are on the free plan, and exporting will never become a paid feature.
  2. 2 Files you can read Backups are plain, versioned JSON. Never encrypted, never a format only we can open.
  3. 3 Leave with everything Your account or a whole workspace downloads as one file. A downgrade never deletes a board.

Free: unlimited boards, 5 editors, 3 AI prompts a day, no card. Team: $5 per editor a month. Viewers never pay.

Pricing details

问题

直接回答。

  • What can the AI draw? Plans with steps and tasks, flowcharts, mind maps, system diagrams with real cloud and brand logos, sticky notes, text and frames. Describe it in words, paste notes, attach images or video, or point it at a document on the board. It also sums up a board, sorts sticky notes into themes and suggests ideas. Everything it draws is ordinary content: edit it, restyle it or undo it one step at a time.
  • Is the AI free? 是的。 The free plan includes 3 AI prompts a day (up to 250,000 tokens a month), with no card. Team adds 1M tokens per editor a month and Business 3.5M, pooled for the whole workspace.
  • What if I want to leave? Take everything with you. Every board exports to PNG, SVG, PDF, draw.io or plain JSON on every plan, and your account or a whole workspace downloads as one JSON file. Nothing is encrypted and a downgrade never deletes a board.
  • Can I import boards from another whiteboard app? 是的。 Import → From Miro… copies frames, sticky notes, text, shapes, cards and connectors from that app through its API, up to 10,000 items at a time; your token is used once and never stored. draw.io files and Whiboard JSON backups drop straight onto a board. Encrypted backup files from other tools can only be read by the tool that made them, so those cannot be imported.
  • Do my teammates need an account? Viewers don't: anyone with a share link can open the board. Editors join the workspace; the free plan has five seats per workspace and you can own five workspaces. On Team, guests can also edit from a link without an account.
